item.title: The final chapter begins: top storylines and how to watch the 2026 Powerball Cup
item.description:
The Disc Golf Pro Tour's season finale is here. The 2026 Powerball Cup — the final chapter of the DGPT season — gets a full preview covering the top storylines to watch and how to follow the action.

It matters because this is the tournament that closes the book on the 2026 season: season-long narratives get settled, final standings take shape, and players make their last big statements of the year. If you follow the tour, this is the one event preview worth reading before the weekend — it lays out who's in contention, what the stakes are, and where to watch every throw.

Sources

  • Disc Golf Pro Tour: The Final Chapter Begins! Top Storylines & How to Watch the 2026 Powerball Cup

item.title: Foundation's Q3 2026 sales data: the discs players actually bought
item.description:
Foundation Disc Golf dug into third-quarter sales data to rank the 50 most popular disc molds on its site — a look at what players are actually buying, not just what's hyped. The breakdown covers which molds topped the charts, what drove each disc's position (major releases, limited editions, special events, or steady popularity), and which trends stand out heading into Q4.

It matters as a reality check on disc golf's equipment market: limited runs and signature releases can skew the rankings, and the post calls out where promotional spikes inflated the numbers. For bag-builders, it's a useful read on which molds have genuine staying power versus flash-in-the-pan demand — and a hint at what to watch for in the holiday buying season.

Sources

  • Foundation Disc Golf - Blog: Best Selling Disc Golf Disc - Q3 2026

item.title: Relive the top moments from the 2026 USDGC and Throw Pink Championship
item.description:
The Disc Golf Pro Tour published a recap of the top moments from the 2026 USDGC and Throw Pink Championship at Winthrop — Calvin Heimburg's USDGC victory and Holyn Handley's Throw Pink win among them. If you missed the weekend's action, this is the fastest way to catch the highlights.

Full tournament coverage of Heimburg's win is available from the tour's earlier reporting.
